## Review checklist

- [ ] This is a draft for review; no deployment is implied.
- [ ] The change is limited to the described behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog match the implementation.
- [ ] Browser tests are distinguished from hardware tests.
- [ ] No untested hardware/profile is called verified.
- [ ] Mute state is not inferred from a level value.
- [ ] Original working projects and existing routing were not changed incidentally.
- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, personal recordings, private messages or unnecessary device/network identifiers are included.
- [ ] Third-party material has recorded permission/license and attribution, or none was added.
